main_topics.reason: The user came to learn what preventatives exist and spent most of the conversation comparing injectable, oral and older options.
The stated goal was to go in prepared, and the user asked for a list of questions to bring.
The user asked about side effects and precautions for the oral option in one turn and the bot answered.
The user called insurance the wild card and asked whether older drugs must fail first, which took a couple of turns.
The condition frames the whole conversation, but the user did not describe symptoms.

output.summary: The user has chronic migraine and wanted to understand preventative options before a neurologist visit. The bot covered injectable and oral CGRP-class options, older oral preventatives, insurance step therapy and a list of questions to bring. The user said it was exactly what they needed and planned to ask about an oral option the bot named.
